# ListItemButton

Clickable list item

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: ListItemButton

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { ListItemButton } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<ListItemButton onClick={() => {}}>
  <ListItemText primary="Clickable Item" />
</ListItemButton>
```

## Examples

